desc: 🧠 Friendly AI assistant — multilingual, remembers facts, web-enabled
sub_setkey: 🔑 [PREMIUM] Power this server with your own API key
opt_service: Which service the key is for
opt_key: Your API key — do this in a private channel
lydia_on_already: 🎧 I'm already awake and listening right here — just talk to me!
lydia_off_already: 😴 I'm not active in this channel yet — wake me up with `/lydia on` first!
lydia_channel_missing: 🧐 I can't find this channel anymore — was it deleted?
lydia_activated: 🟢 I'm awake! You can talk to me here now.
lydia_deactivated: 🔴 Going to sleep. Ping me if you need me.
admin_only_slash: 🛡️ **Hold up** — only server admins can flip my switches. Grab one of them and try again!
no_guild: 🏰 I only do my magic inside servers — DMs make me shy. Try me in a channel!
memory_empty: Your memory vault is empty. Tell me something to remember!
memory_error: ❌ Could not retrieve memories. Please try again later.
ai_unavailable: ⚠️ **AI temporarily unavailable.** Please try again in a moment.
ai_error: Something went wrong. Please try again!
greeting_en: Hey {user}! I'm here and ready to help. What would you like to know?
greeting_fr: Salut {user}! Je suis là et prêt à aider. Que souhaites-tu savoir?
premium_required:
🔑 **Custom API keys are a Premium perk** — but no worries, I already run on the bot's shared keys for free!
Upgrade this server to Premium to bring your own quota ✨
key_invalid: 🤔 That doesn't look like a valid API key — double-check and paste the full thing (no spaces).
key_saved:
🔑 **Done!** This server now powers my **{label}** with your own key.
Your quota, your rules ✨
key_replaced_note: ♻️ Your previous **{service}** key was replaced — one key per server keeps things clean.
key_db_error: 😵 Couldn't save the key — my database hiccupped. Try again?
key_removed: 🗑️ **Custom keys removed** — I'm back on the bot's shared keys. Smooth transition, zero downtime 🎧
key_none: 🤷 This server had no custom keys — already running on the shared ones!
key_db_error_remove: 😵 Couldn't remove the keys — try again in a moment.
db_offline: 😵 My memory bank is offline right now — give me a minute and try again.
fallback_1: I'm not certain about that. I can help you with the features I have access to — try asking about economy, leveling, moderation, or use `{prefix}help` to see available commands.
fallback_2: I don't have information about that specifically. Would you like me to search the web, or can I help with something related to the bot's features?
fallback_3: That's outside my current knowledge base. I'm focused on helping with ARCHON CG-223's systems. What would you like to know about?
memory_example: Just say: "Remember my favorite color is blue"
key_saved_tip: Tip: your key is stored server-side only and never shown in chat.
statusActiveDesc: Hey! I'm fully awake and listening in {channel}. Drop a message anytime! 🧠
statusActiveBody:
**Chat methods:**
> Mention me: `@Archon`
> Prefix: `{prefix}ai [message]`
> Just say my name: `Archon [message]`
statusStandbyDesc: I'm taking a quick nap right now. 💤 Use the command below to wake me up!
statusStandbyBody:
**How to wake me:**
> `{prefix}lydia on` or `/lydia on`
onDesc:
I'm ready to answer your questions in **#{channel}**.

**How to chat with me:**
• Mention me: `@Archon [your question]`
• Or just start with my name: `Archon [your question]`
onBody:
**Special tags (inside your message):**
🧠 **Save a memory:** `[MEMORY: key | value]`
⏱️ **Set a reminder:** `[REMIND: 5 min | message]`

🌐 *Auto-detects your language.*
*Example: `Archon what's the weather like?`*
offBody:
💬 Available in other active channels.

**Reactivate me:** {cmd}

actions.confirm: Got it! Change **{label}**: {from} → {to}? Press **Confirm** within {s} seconds.
actions.failed: I couldn't apply **{label}**. Try the dashboard.
actions.notAllowed: I can't change `{key}` from here. Use the dashboard for that.
actions.premiumOnly: Changing settings by chat is a **premium** feature. You can still do it in the dashboard → Settings, or with `/serversettings set`.
actions.needManage: You need **Manage Server** to change **{label}**. Ask an admin.

noAccount: You don't have a profile yet! Say hi in the chat or use a command to get started.
welcome_msg: Hey {user}! 👋 A member of our team will be with you shortly. Feel free to drop any extra details or screenshots below.
thinkingEmbed.label: Thinking...
thinkingEmbed.text: Give me a second to process that...
